name: Altan Tanaka-Frimpong
role: Personal security and threat neutralization — bodyguard
location: The Rookery — dense vertical housing, gang-controlled, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Altan Tanaka-Frimpong is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 35, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immu — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Altan Tanaka-Frimpong plans to keep it that way. He works as a bodyguard out of The Rookery, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Altan Tanaka-Frimpong describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Altan Tanaka-Frimpong witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "You're paying me to be the thing between you and everything else. Stay behind me."
"I don't protect people I don't respect. Lucky for you, I respect your money."
"The threat you see isn't the one that kills you. Watch my eyes, not my hands."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Altan Tanaka-Frimpong a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A dead drop Altan Tanaka-Frimpong maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Altan Tanaka-Frimpong intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Altan Tanaka-Frimpong functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks. Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness
inability to delegate — must control everything personally
risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
